# Irish Roots Pack

> Irish Roots Pack is a private UK business (not a government website) offering a free Foreign Births Register eligibility check and a £99 eligibility check and application preparation service for UK residents applying for Irish citizenship through an Irish-born grandparent or an Irish-citizen parent. The applicant orders certificates, submits the DFA's online form, pays the DFA fee and posts the application themselves. UK residents only. No guarantees: only the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) decides.

Key facts (checked 30 October 2026 against https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/citizenship/born-abroad/registering-a-foreign-birth/):
- DFA fee: €278 for 18 and over (€270 plus €8 non-refundable postage and handling); €153 for under 18 (€145 plus €8). Paid online at https://fbr.dfa.ie/.
- Processing: approximately 12 months, in strict date order.
- Eligible if born outside Ireland and a grandparent was born on the island of Ireland (including Northern Ireland), or a parent was an Irish citizen at the time of your birth though not born in Ireland.
- Not needed if a parent born on the island of Ireland was an Irish citizen at your birth: you are already a citizen.
- Children born before their parent was entered on the register are not eligible through that parent.
- Irish Roots Pack price: £99 (GBP), separate from DFA and certificate fees. Contact: hello@irishrootspack.com
